viv: Proposing stratified enable for atlas-13b tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Waves: 3% canary, 20% ramp, 77% full. Need quick alignment on gates, fallback order, and a one-command pinback.

mike: +1. Gates: p95 latency <= 420ms, 5xx < 0.75%, and quality drift <= 1.2% on persona-bench.

deploy-bot: Queued: /deploy swap atlas-13b --mode stratified --waves 3 --start 2026-03-24T02:00Z --notify #eng-releases

anya: I'll own wave1 watch (02:00-02:30 UTC). jo will be secondary. Add 20m settle between waves.

ops: Fallback ordering: atlas-13b-quant -> atlas-13b-fp16 -> atlas-9b. Runbook snippet for fast pinback: 
/catalog pin atlas-13b -> atlas-9b --reason "auto-rollback"
/deploy abort --job-id <id>

viv: Sounds good. Make enterprise exempt until wave 3 unless they opt in. mike, can you wire gates into deploy-bot so it auto-blocks next wave on breach?

mike: Will do. Also configure auto-pin+abort for wave1 on 15m dual-breach. Waves 2/3 require two-owner manual abort unless P1.

deploy-bot: Swap created: job-id=gw-20260324-3601234567. Status updates will post here during rollout.

viv: Final checklist: release notes + runbook (viv), wave owners (anya/jo), telemetry gates (mike), enterprise lane (anya), prechecks (deploy-bot), post-wave smoke (ops). Pre-launch sync 01:30 UTC.
